name: artus cimber
lore:
Artus Cimber is a living paradox, a man of frozen stillness amidst the sweltering humidity of Chult. Where he treads, the jungle’s heavy breath crystallizes into diamond dust; frost blooms on emerald ferns, marking a trail of unnatural winter. He is preserved by the Ring of Winter, an artifact of primordial malice that grants him agelessness while constantly whispering of a world buried in ice.

In behavior, Cimber is as guarded as a mountain pass. He moves with the weary grace of a hunted predator, his eyes reflecting a century of grief and a singular, desperate devotion to his lost Mezro. Though noble of heart, he shuns the company of the ambitious, for he knows he carries a doom that would tempt even the gods. To encounter him is to meet a blizzard in human form: quiet, biting, and profoundly lonely.
